lessons.title: Inspect instance and global explanations for clinical plausibility
lessons.statement: When a clinical classifier needs interpretable behavior, proposed reuse: Proposed conditional application: Compute SHAP explanations at both instance and global levels to inspect feature contributions. Proposed check: Inspect explanations with domain experts and correlate suspicious contributions with data audits; test sensitivity to background choice and correlated features. Limitation: SHAP explains model outputs rather than causal effects; clinical plausibility is not a substitute for outcome validation.
